summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed a prospectus supplement for a direct offering of 8,539,709 common shares at $0.5855 per share to a single institutional investor, with no underwriters. Concurrently, it will amend existing warrants covering up to 15,488,570 shares to reduce their exercise price from a weighted average of $1.78 to $0.5855. The offering price equals the last reported sale price, so no premium. Closing is expected on May 29, 2026. This is a routine at-the-market capital raise, not a special situation.
